loc.forest.name: Whispering Forest
loc.forest.description: Tall pines creak in the wind. Paths wind east to a clearing, south to a dark cave and west along an old paved road.

loc.clearing.name: Sunlit Clearing
loc.clearing.description: A peaceful glade carpeted with wild herbs. A rusty blade lies half-buried in the moss.

loc.cave.name: Goblin Cave
loc.cave.description: A damp cave that reeks of smoke. Crude drawings cover the walls, and a tunnel slopes down into the rock.

loc.old_road.name: The Old Road
loc.old_road.description: Paving stones older than the village, heaved up by roots. A fallen tree blocks half the road - a good place for an ambush.

loc.hunters_camp.name: Hunter's Camp
loc.hunters_camp.description: A lean-to, a smoking fire and pelts stretched on frames. A cart track runs south toward the hills where the old mine is.

loc.deep_woods.name: Deep Woods
loc.deep_woods.description: The canopy closes overhead and the light turns green. Paths lead west to a ring of oaks, south into a web-choked hollow and east toward the smell of marsh.

loc.druid_grove.name: Grove of Thorn
loc.druid_grove.description: Seven oaks stand in a perfect ring around a still pool. Pale flowers float on the water and open when you look away.

loc.spider_hollow.name: Spider Hollow
loc.spider_hollow.description: Webs thick as sailcloth hang between the trees. Things are wrapped in them. Some are still moving.

item.goblin_totem.name: Goblin Totem
item.goblin_totem.description: A crude carved idol taken from the goblin chief.

item.moonpetal.name: Moonpetal
item.moonpetal.description: A pale flower that glows faintly. Wenna needs these.

item.spider_silk.name: Spider Silk
item.spider_silk.description: A bundle of silk strong enough to hang a cow from.

item.hunters_bow.name: Hunter's Bow
item.hunters_bow.description: Rolf's spare bow. Surprisingly handy up close, too.

item.bandit_cloak.name: Bandit's Cloak
item.bandit_cloak.description: Dark wool with a lot of hidden pockets, all of them empty.

npc.wolf.name: Grey Wolf
npc.wolf.description: Hungry yellow eyes stare at you.

npc.goblin.name: Goblin Chief
npc.goblin.description: A scarred goblin with a crown of bones.
dialogue: You no take cave! Cave belongs to Gruk!

npc.bandit.name: Road Bandit
npc.bandit.description: A masked figure leaning on the fallen tree, flipping a knife.
dialogue: Toll's everything you've got. Or we can do this the fun way.

npc.spider.name: Giant Spider
npc.spider.description: Eight legs, eight eyes, and all of them on you.

npc.hunter.name: Hunter Rolf
npc.hunter.description: Weathered, patient, and missing two fingers on his left hand.

hunt.text: There's a spider in the hollow south of the deep woods, big as a cart. It took my dog. Kill it and bring me its silk; I'll make it worth your while.

roads.text: East back to the forest and your village. South of this camp, the cart track to Dain's mine. The deep woods are south of the road - the druid lives there, if you like talking to trees.

npc.druid.name: Elder Thorn
npc.druid.description: Bark-brown skin, moss in his beard, and eyes the colour of the pool.

start.text: The grove listens. So do I.

options.text: Wenna sent me. Where do moonpetals bloom now?

petals.text: Where the water is still: here in my pool, and among the reeds by the lake. They grow back, slowly. Take only what you need.

options.text: I will take only what I need.
I'll take as many as I like.

greed.text: Then the grove will remember you.

lore.text: Older than the village. Older than the lake's name. Something hollow sleeps in the tower on the hill, and the roots feel it turning over.

q.spider_hunt.title: The Hollow Spider
q.spider_hunt.description: Hunter Rolf wants the giant spider of the hollow dead, and its silk as proof.

steps.description: Kill the Giant Spider in the hollow south of the deep woods.
Bring the Spider Silk to Hunter Rolf.
